description: One-click local AI smoke test of the ai/local-setup branch: ai.localPlan, then ai.localInstall with real downloads, then chat, embeddings and transcription through the executor (/v1 and RPC). One device; a smoke test, not a wind-tunnel measurement. The seed recommendations name this file for the cpu-8gb tier because those are the models it ran; it ran them on the device below, so its numbers are an upper bound for a real 8 GB CPU machine.

device.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (16 cores, 32 threads; avx2, avx512f)

stt.note: whisper.cpp publishes no Linux GPU build

install.note: network-bound, about 25 MB/s; every file sha256-checked before use

llm.request: POST /v1/chat/completions, model default, 'Name the capital of France in one word.', max_tokens 400
llm.note: Qwen3.5 thinks first; ai.prompt sends no max_tokens, so its time follows the length of the thought. Later runs cap thinking at 1024 tokens (reasoning-budget in the preset).

stt.request: POST /v1/audio/transcriptions, whisper.cpp samples/jfk.wav (11.0 s, 16 kHz mono)
stt.text: And so my fellow Americans ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
stt.note: warm 0.30 to 0.39 s on 32 CPU threads; the 22.9 s first call after a restart ran while other builds loaded the machine

residentMemoryMB.note: RSS; the chat model's weights sit in GPU-mapped memory and do not all count here
